acceptance_criteria: Disk report covers the C: and D: drives with total, used, and free space.
Any drive under 10% free is flagged by name in the report.
A PNG screenshot of the disk report is attached.
The result email uses the exact subject [JARVIS-RESULT] disk-audit-002.
goal: On the bridge PC, audit local disk space. Steps: 1) Run a shell command that lists every fixed drive with total, used, and free space (PowerShell Get-PSDrive or equivalent). 2) Flag any drive with under 10% free space by name. 3) Save the full output to disk-report.txt inside the workspace and take a PNG screenshot showing it. 4) Do not delete, move, or modify anything — read-only. Report back with the exact result subject: [JARVIS-RESULT] disk-audit-002.
report_back: Per-drive total/used/free figures, the flagged drives (if any), and the screenshot.
